# Ubuntu 24.04 packages for building and testing cef-qml (Qt 6.4.2).
# Installed with --no-install-recommends by .github/workflows/*.yml.

# Build
meson
ninja-build
g++
pkg-config
python3

# Qt
qt6-base-dev
qt6-base-dev-tools
qt6-declarative-dev
qt6-declarative-dev-tools
qml-qt6
qml6-module-qtquick
qml6-module-qtquick-window
qml6-module-qtqml-workerscript
qml6-module-qttest
# Optional at runtime (Browser's file dialogs); tested with it, as users have it.
qml6-module-qtquick-dialogs

# Wayland test suite (private headless compositor)
qt6-wayland
weston
libgl1-mesa-dri
libegl-mesa0

# CEF runtime
libnss3
libnspr4
libasound2t64
